en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a historic European town taken from a grassy hillside in the foreground. The middle ground shows half‑timbered houses, masonry buildings, and portions of old fortification walls on a slope. A notable square stone tower with battlements rises above the town, and further back a large baroque-style church with a tall tower and spire dominates the skyline. Trees and gardens are interspersed among the densely packed roofs.
